ms.promise:
・C source code for a transaction builder capable of creating all types of valid Cardano transactions up to Conway era:

・Transferring Value between addresses (both ADA and native assets).
・Spending outputs that are guarded by Plutus scripts (up to Plutus V3).
・Minting assets using Plutus scripts (up to Plutus V3).
・Spending outputs that are guarded by Native scripts.
・Minting assets using Native scripts.
・Issue all available certificates in Conway era as specified in https://github.com/IntersectMBO/cardano-ledger/blob/master/eras/conway/impl/cddl-files/conway.cddl#L275-L293.
・Attaching auxiliary data to the transaction.
・Quality assurance report including testing, MISRA compliance verification, and Valgrind memory management checks.
ms.criteria:
・Transaction builder supports the creation of all Cardano transaction types up to Conway era and is verified through testing. Test coverage covers: 

・Transferring Value between addresses (both ADA and native assets).
・Spending outputs that are guarded by Plutus scripts (up to Plutus V3).
・Minting assets using Plutus scripts (up to Plutus V3).
・Spending outputs that are guarded by Native scripts.
・Minting assets using Native scripts.
・Issue all available certificates in Conway era as specified in https://github.com/IntersectMBO/cardano-ledger/blob/master/eras/conway/impl/cddl-files/conway.cddl
ms.report:
Catalyst Project Review Team,
I am pleased to share with you the documentation detailing the completion of Milestone 4 for the Cardano C project. The Proof of Achievement (PoA) outlines the deliverables for the high-level transaction builder that can:
・Transfer value between addresses
・Spend outputs that are guarded by Plutus scripts (up to Plutus V3)
・Mint assets using Plutus scripts (up to Plutus V3)
・Spend outputs that are guarded by Native scripts
・Mint assets using Native scripts
・Issue all available certificates in Conway era
・Attach auxiliary data to the transaction

You can access the documentation through the following link:

Angel
